notes.title: Major Demo Update v1.2 – New Hero, Stats, UI Improvements & More!
notes.notes:
The Slime Attack: Survivor demo just got a huge upgrade — with tighter gameplay, more personality, and a brand-new hero joining the fight!

🆕 What's New in v1.2:
✨ New Stats
Including Luck, Interest, and more — opening up new build possibilities.

🃏 New Hero: The Jester
A chaotic and luck-driven fighter bringing unpredictability and charm.

🕹️ Improved UI & Controller Support
Navigation is smoother and more intuitive across menus and gameplay.

⏱️ Faster Runs
We've halved the length — now 10 waves instead of 20 for quicker, more action-packed sessions.

📈 Progress Tracking
You can now see which difficulties you've cleared with each hero.

🎯 Smarter Spell Offerings
Spells are now more likely to match your current build (projectile vs. area).

🧠 New Passive Abilities
Tons of new passives, including one that boosts projectile count and area size while running.

💬 Hero Catchphrases
Each hero now has unique voice lines during character select for extra personality.

🎵 New Music
A fresh soundtrack to enhance your slime-slaying sessions (let me know what you think!).

💥 Impactful Combat
Weapon hits now include camera shake (optional in settings).

❤️ Low HP Effects
Heartbeat SFX and a screen-darkening effect add tension when your health gets low (also optional).

🚀 Try the Updated Demo Now!

🎮 Play & Wishlist on Steam

notes.title: 🔥 Game Update – New Item Upgrade System & Major Balance Changes! 🔥
notes.notes:
The biggest update yet is here! I've revamped progression, reworked balance, and introduced a brand-new Item Upgrade System to make every run more exciting.

🆕 Major Features:

🔧 New Item Upgrade System  Customize your build like never before! Each upgrade offers choices (some RNG-based), adding deeper strategy and unique playstyles every run.

🛒 Shop Improvements  Once you buy an item, it won’t appear again, making upgrades faster and more efficient! No more clutter—just the gear you need.

⚖️ Balance System & Difficulty Scaling A smoother progression curve for a more rewarding challenge without unnecessary spikes.

🗺️ Map Size Adjustments  Smaller, more action-packed battlefields to keep the intensity high! Less wandering, more fighting.

🩸 Lifesteal Rework Now applies only to weapons & spells. Multi-hit attacks trigger lifesteal only once, making it more balanced.

❤️ HP Overhaul  HP has doubled, with all HP-scaling mechanics adjusted accordingly for better survivability and strategy.

This update makes every decision more impactful, every upgrade more rewarding, and every battle more intense. 💥

Jump in now and start shaping your ultimate build! 🚀

notes.title: Slime Attack: Survivor - Demo Update 1.14!
notes.notes:
I’m excited to share Demo 1.14, bringing some big new features and improvements to the game!

🐾 New Pet System
Every hero now has a unique pet that fights alongside them! These loyal companions add a new layer of strategy, helping you take down enemies in their own way.

🧙‍♂️ New Hero: Necromancer & New Staff - Tombcaller
A powerful new hero joins the fight! The Necromancer commands the undead, summoning zombies with his signature Tombcaller Staff to overwhelm enemies. Designed after "Broken's Playz"!

🗺️ Bigger Map & More Challenge
The battlefield has been expanded, giving you more space to maneuver. Difficulty 3 is now more challenging, pushing your skills to the limit!

🔍 Zoom Out with Mouse Scroll
You can now zoom out slightly using the mouse scroll, giving you better battlefield awareness and control.

I hope you enjoy the update! As always, I’d love to hear your feedback—thanks for playing! 🎮

notes.title: 🔥 Slime Attack: Survivor – Demo Update v1.12 is Here! 🔥
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45422958/4b3fe2d880c60b7210d4efe5b2545f0d1b719b13.png

Brace yourself for an electrifying new experience! The latest update completely overhauls the battlefield, introduces new strategic challenges, and brings powerful new ways to enhance your playstyle. Here's what’s new:

🧑‍🎨  Enhanced Game Environment: The environment has been completely redone, making every wave more immersivethan ever!

⚔️ New Challenge System: Random challenges now appear on certain waves! Complete them to earn powerful rewards and push your survival to the next level!

🪨 Rocky Obstacles: Rocks now block the path of both you and enemies, forcing you to adapt your movement and strategy!

💨 Dash Rework & New Passive: Dash no longer costs HP but has a +2s cooldown. Want the old dash back? Buy a new passive that brings back the HP cost, reduces cooldown, and grants a DMG buff when dashing!

⚡ Sprint Passive Raises Dodge Cap: A new Sprint Passive now raises the dodge cap from 60% to 80%, letting you evade even more attacks! Plus, even more interactive and fun passives to discover!

❤️ HP Bar Markers: Instantly gauge your max HP with new visual markers!

⚖️ Balancing Tweaks: Fine-tuned for even smoother and more satisfying gameplay!

Try out the update and share your feedback. Your input is invaluable in enhancing the game experience. 🎮
